title: 第87章 摇人第86章 搜索盲区
content_zh:
“呼，总算回来了！这次有点惊险，没想到真有九阶的魔尊藏在这下面。”回到地下城据点，石小军他们三人都累得不轻，全程精神紧张。
石乐志精神振奋，“没想到他们还真的躲在这地下湖上面，这次我们的榜首名次跑不了了。”
“九哥，你别太激动，它们有九阶的魔尊，以我们的军团实力，对付不了。”石乐志已经是家族里的顶尖强者，但也只有八阶的修为，对付不了九阶魔尊。
“嘿嘿，没事，我们可以找几个盟友一起合作，魔尊不算什么，我有的是人。”
不客气的说，现在军团排行榜上，前百的基本都是有九阶强者统领的，只有他们石家军以八阶统领之力，冲进前十。
因为竞争激烈，一百名之外的许多军团，也有九阶统领，只要石乐志私聊几句，他们很乐意过来帮忙。
“先确定一下他们的整体数量与实力评估，看看需要找多少人，太多的话积分不够分，大家都赚得少，不划算，人不够又会提高战损，同样不划算。”
两位长老也只是用神识一扫而过，准确的人数信息肯定是得不到的，只能大概的评估一下。
“湖上有大规模的平板船，有许多人在船上忙碌，像是在生产什么东西……总体人口的话，我估计会有二十到三十万，九阶的气息，我只感应到一个，但八阶有好几个。”
“我感觉不止，那些平板船，是分层的，我觉得他们人口会超过三十万。”
“如果你们都不确定，那就按最高的估算数据为基准。”石乐志估算一下，这种迁移族群，一般都只挑选精英，所以战斗人员数量不会少，应该有五到十万。
他们石家军确实是啃不下来，还需要再招募三到五支军团共同出手。
如果是强大的精英军团，那三个应该就够了，但这些军团，在榜单上积分一般都不低，带上他们等于给自己扶持一个竞争者，所以他只会挑选一百名之外的军团帮助。
石乐志在聊天群里迅速挑选合作伙伴，很快就确定了五名实力不弱，但排名并不如意的军团。
“赶紧的，到七号地下城据点来，绝对的超级大鱼。”
“五千精锐过来就行，都用遁地符下来，别浪费时间，值，绝对值！”
“快点，对方已经发现位置暴露，恐怕会有后续动作，再不来它们就要逃了。”
石家军现在是榜上的耀眼明星，石乐志本人也在各个军团统领群里大受欢迎，许多统领都在追问他有什么秘法搜寻地下魔鼠。
所以他摇人的速度很快，统领们对他的信任基础还是很深的。
大半天之后，陆续有人透过岩石层，落在这处地下城据点。

“石兄，别诳人啊，真有超级大鱼才好，我可是中止了一次扫荡任务特意带队赶过来的。”
“老刘，别废话，赶紧休整一下，人齐了就马上出发。”
“共享一下地图信息，我看看目标位置在哪里，这片区域我记得之前也扫描过，怎么没发现有大鱼呢。”
“林统领，你也来了！石大哥，这次的鱼真有这么大吗？居然还要摇这么多人？我还以为就我们李家军就够了呢。”
content_en:
"Huh, I'm finally back! This time it was a bit thrilling. I didn't expect that there was a ninth-level demon lord hiding under here." Back at the dungeon stronghold, Shi Xiaojun and the other three were very tired and nervous throughout the process.
Shi Lezhi was in high spirits, "I didn't expect them to be hiding in this underground lake. This time we won't be able to get to the top spot."
"Brother Ninth, don't be too excited. They have ninth-level demons. With the strength of our army, we can't deal with them." Shi Lezhi is already the top powerhouse in the family, but he only has an eighth-level cultivation and cannot deal with the ninth-level demons.
"Hehe, it's okay. We can find a few allies to work together. The Demon Lord is nothing. I have plenty of people."
To put it bluntly, on the current legion rankings, the top 100 are basically led by ninth-level warriors. Only their Shi Jiajun broke into the top ten with the power of their eighth-level commander.
Because of the fierce competition, many legions beyond the hundred also had ninth-level commanders. As long as Shi Lezhi chatted a few words in private, they would be happy to come and help.
"First determine their overall number and strength assessment, and see how many people need to be found. If there are too many, there will not be enough points, and everyone will earn less, which is not cost-effective. Not enough people will increase the battle losses, which is also not cost-effective."
The two elders just scanned it with their spiritual senses. Accurate information on the number of people was definitely not available, so they could only make a rough assessment.
"There are large-scale flat boats on the lake, and many people are busy on the boats, as if they are producing something... In terms of the total population, I estimate there are 200,000 to 300,000 people. I can only sense one ninth-level aura, but there are several eighth-level ones."
"I feel more than that. Those flat boats are layered. I think their population will exceed 300,000."
"If you are not sure, then use the highest estimate as the benchmark." Shi Lezhi estimated that this kind of migration group usually only selects elites, so the number of combatants will not be small, there should be five to one hundred thousand.
The Shi Jiajun really can't take it down, and they need to recruit three to five more legions to jointly attack.
If it is a powerful elite legion, then three should be enough, but these legions generally have high points on the list. Bringing them is equivalent to supporting a competitor for himself, so he will only choose legions other than a hundred to help.
Shi Lezhi quickly selected partners in the chat group and quickly identified five legions that were not weak in strength but not ranked as expected.
"Hurry up and come to the No. 7 underground city stronghold. It's an absolute super fish."
"Just come here with five thousand elites. Use the Earth Escape Talisman to get down. Don't waste your time. It's worth it. It's absolutely worth it!"
"Hurry up, the other party has discovered that their position has been exposed. I'm afraid there will be follow-up actions. If they don't come, they will escape."
Shi Jiajun is now a dazzling star on the list, and Shi Lezhi himself is also very popular among the leaders of various legions. Many leaders are asking him about his secret method to search for underground demon rats.
Therefore, he moved people very quickly, and the commanders' trust in him was still very deep.
After more than half a day, people one after another came through the rock layer and landed in this underground city stronghold.
"Brother Shi, don't lie to me. There really is a super big fish. I stopped a sweep mission and led the team here specially."
"Old Liu, don't talk nonsense. Take a rest and set off as soon as everyone is here."
"Share the map information and let me see where the target location is. I remember scanning this area before, but I didn't find any big fish."
"Commander Lin, you're here too! Brother Shi, are the fish really that big this time? Are there actually so many people trying to catch them? I thought our Li family army would be enough."
